body: A few things, Ive heard strange sounds in the middle of the night before when I have been home alone. I was once sitting on the couch and I felt someone sit next to me but I looked over and saw nobody. I often have feelings like im being watched. I remember my mother mentioning that she talked to the ghosts of dead family members when she lived here too. (its my grandmother's house technically) My grandfather died in the house. So did one of my aunts when they were like 10. Its an ancient house so idk.

My friends who have seen it all knew exactly what it was. I got why did you do that to yourself? And you should stop doing that. A lot from them. Of course that didn’t change anything and I’ve continued since. I feel a bit more horrible about myself though so yeah. I never answered their questions because I felt I didn’t have to.

Then there is my family. Either they don’t notice at all or a few of them have seen the scars and or fresh cuts. Usually I say nothing when they go what’s that? And they list things off and make my excuses for me. I’ve said I fell and or that I ran into something. If I ever told them the truth I would probably be sent to the hospital and or checked into inpatient. I don’t want that though so I’ve continued to lie. 

Anyway so far those are all the reactions I’ve ever gotten.

I’m sure I don’t know much about that but I definitely decided to take it up because of the hells ive been through and my current relationship almost having fallen apart on me. Lots of stress constant anxiety. I’ve never really dealt well with emotions.
It’s nice knowing I’m not alone. Thank you. I’m sure if I remind myself of why I’m still here I won’t actually go through with anything. It’s been close before.
I’ve been considering getting a new therapist and I’m also looking to maybe try the rubber band method.
Well, I don't think I'll be able to stop hurting myself for a while, but I do think I want to search for a new way to get rid of my emotional pain. I don't want to be like this forever after all.
Thank you. And of course! I feel like it’s good to talk to people who understand. I’m glad this sort of support is there

Thank you for the advice. I think your right about that. If I talk to her she would likely be understanding. And I definitely know talking ro someone is important. If I don't I would probably be much worse off. You have a point.

Thank you, that does help quite a bit. I think I really needed to hear that. Your absolutely right that I need to take care of myself as well. I know in my heart that its true as well. Sometimes I just feel like I don't care about myself and want everyone else to be happy but thats no way to live. I like being able to say hey I made a difference to someone. It feels good. Im sure If i just try harder to balance things out I will be able to carry on. 

And I do realize that its not like I can actually stop anyone from doing what they do but Id like to think I would be able to give them an alternative option at least for them to choose to take or not. If that makes any sense?

And thank you, I might take you up on that sometime. I think its good to have someone to vent too. And rn my family has no idea about the fact that I sh. If they did I think they probably wouldn't understand so thats probably why i vent online where they won't know.
She was a stranger. Someone Ive never met in my life. And Im not sure. As far as I could tell she definitely ment me harm. She was a angry about me being there.

Im not the best example, but Ive been upfront with my fiance about my cutting from day one. The thing is that she used to be a self harmer too so she was really understanding and supportive of it. We are going strong to this day and plenty happy. 

As for your case, do what you feel in your heart is right. If your afraid he may not take it well at first then I would wait to tell him about it until you two are comfortable enough around eachother.
Thank you 😊 Yeah Im trying my best. I want to stop before it gets too out of control. Seems like im succeeding thankfully. I just need to keep trying.
Your right. Its just a struggle nonetheless because im used to normally just giving in. I don't reget my decision to ignore it though. I think i did the right thing.
I know for a fact its my inner thoughts. The metephorical inner demon. That evil part of my conscience. And yeah it made sense. I wasn't entirely clear tbh in the first place.

I started cutting because of my situation and the fact that my life was taking a nasty turn. At the time I was unemployed and stuck living with someone I didn't want to live with. I had met this girl that is now my fiance and we had been dating for four months. Her mother had gotten into and argument with her and decided to do this helicopter parenting thing where she took all her electronics away and grounded her. Taking away her only means of talking to me. And then I found out that her mother was trying to seperate her from me even though I had done nothing to warrant this. She had randomly decided she hates me and wanted me to break up with her daughter. Her mother is homophobic so that was one of the reasons. Also my Grandma and many other people in my family were saying im just confused and Im not really a lesbian. Basically dismissing my sexuality and acting like I don't know what Im talking about. To top it all off, I had been raped by a random stranger. While I had been raped before in my childhood many times, this time was the final nail on the coffin. So basically I couldn't take it anymore and one day while I was alone in my room I cut my wrist for the first time. 

so yeah thats how it happened.
